q1_issues.issue: "giant" is an incidental-description (size) modifier on a plural, which the Compound-concepts rule says must distribute over the group's members like a copular predicate (a rule over (PartOf $x sk_poster_1)), not be predicated of the group symbol itself as (Member sk_poster_1 giant).

q2_gaps: depiction / "about" of-phrase on an entity ("posters of Saddam Hussein", the instruction set's own "a photo of Mary") — it is explicitly excluded from the Possession/PartOf genitive mapping but no replacement representation is specified

episodic bare-plural subject in a past-tense clause ("Giant posters ... adorned public places") — bare plural plus a verbal predicate is routed to a generic Implication rule, and the group-witness/existential-plural reading needed for a past episodic clause is not addressed
notes: The Name atom, the public_place fusion with its genus plus predicable adjectival modifier, the bare class symbol for the generic object, and Agent on an inanimate transitive subject are all correct. Patient vs Theme on "adorn" is borderline — the places are decorated rather than created/consumed, so the "when unclear, default to Theme" rule arguably applies.
